rationale: Matthew 23:35 names "righteous Abel" directly and places the murder recorded in 4:8 at the start of a line of killings running to Zechariah; "righteous" is Jesus's own qualifier for Abel, not a word Genesis 4 applies to him. The naming is direct, which is why the type is explicit_reference and the label is explicit. Luke 11:51 preserves the same Abel-to-Zechariah pairing in a parallel saying and is not separately authored as its own row here.
